page: Microsoft Azure D32pds_v6 is an ARM-based general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dpdsv6 family. Powered by a Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor with 32 dedicated physical cores running at 3.4 GHz, this instance operates on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. The server is equipped with 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is premium storage capable.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong multi-core capabilities and exceptional memory performance. The instance achieves top-tier status in memory bandwidth for both large-block read and write operations, alongside a top-tier PassMark memory score. Database operations also rank in the top tier, while multi-core CPU performance, static web serving throughput, and multi-threaded decompression are rated as strong. Conversely, single-core metrics and large-model LLM prompt processing show average to poor performance, highlighting a tradeoff where multi-threaded and memory-bound tasks are heavily favored over single-threaded execution.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture delivers high resource density and superior memory throughput relative to its hardware class. The combination of dedicated physical cores, high-speed local NVMe storage, and top-tier database performance makes this server highly suitable for database hosting, multi-threaded web serving, software compilation, and data-intensive general-purpose workloads.
